items.headline: This desktop robot companion is also an AI wearable you can wear around your neck
items.excerpt: Lingverse showcased iKairos at IFA 2026, a modular AI wearable that pops out of a desktop robot body and slots into a neck pendant. It feeds a LifeOS assistant and ships with a physical camera shutter, privacy light and manual mute.

items.headline: Why modular design could be the next big shift for consumer exoskeletons
items.excerpt: At IFA 2026, Ascentiz uses H, K and H+K configurations to show how a single wearable platform can be reconfigured for different kinds of physical assistance.

items.headline: Luna Band takes on Fitbit Air as global shipping finally begins
items.excerpt: Luna announced at IFA 2026 that its screenless AI fitness tracker is now shipping worldwide. The band recognizes patterns in behavior and changes what it measures to adapt to the wearer's goals.

items.headline: Anker's MindBase Wants to Be the Smart Hub for Your Life
items.excerpt: With Matter support, on-device AI and NAS storage, Anker's first AI hub makes a play to be the center of the home, tying Anker and Matter devices into one autonomous system alongside HomeKit, Alexa and Google Home.

items.headline: Would You Buy an AI Smart Home Hub for $20,000?
items.excerpt: Ugreen debuted three products at IFA 2026 that it wants to make the brains of your smart home, topped by a MasterAgent unit priced like a car.

items.headline: This New iRobot Concept Is the Matryoshka of Robot Vacuums
items.excerpt: iRobot's Roomba Duo concept lifts its head off and releases a smaller robot nested inside it, splitting one cleaning machine into two cooperating bodies.

items.headline: Plaud made earbuds for people who want to record every meeting and call
items.excerpt: The Plaud One is a different take on AI wearables: earbuds with built-in eSIM and 4G that capture meetings, calls and face-to-face talks, build memory across days, and hand tasks to an agent.

items.headline: Roborock shows off a series of new vacuums at IFA 2026
items.excerpt: Roborock brought several new robovacs plus a robomower and a pool cleaner to IFA 2026, extending its autonomous-cleaning line into the yard and the water.

items.headline: Anker Eufy at IFA 2026: New security cameras, plus a robot vacuum and a robot lawnmower
items.excerpt: Security was the focus of Anker Eufy at IFA this year, with AI-enhanced cameras leading a lineup that also includes a new robot vacuum and robot lawnmower.

items.headline: IFA 2026 'Best in Show' awards: our 25 favorite reveals at the Berlin tech expo
items.excerpt: TechRadar's picks from the show floor run from somersaulting robots to modular solar batteries for renters, mapping where AI actually landed in this year's hardware.

items.headline: The 9 best new headphones and earbuds we saw at IFA 2026
items.excerpt: From tiny keychain AirTag buds to big Beyerdynamic cans and 'Noise' with sound by Bose, TechRadar rounds up the personal-audio hardware that stood out in Berlin.

items.headline: 'The point isn't that it never misunderstands; it's that the user stays in control' — Plaud on its new AI earbuds
items.excerpt: Plaud explains why its new AI earbuds want to do more than record meetings, and how it designed the agent handoff so the wearer keeps control of what gets acted on.

items.headline: Ugreen releases its first smart speaker with Uliya AI assistant
items.excerpt: Ugreen's first smart speaker pairs a three-driver acoustic system with a four-mic array and the Uliya voice assistant, and can control Matter devices directly by voice.

items.headline: Acer debuts Aspire G 3D 16: glasses-free 3D laptop that can run large local AI models
items.excerpt: The 16-inch Aspire G 3D 16 brings glasses-free stereoscopic 3D to creatives on a 3,840x2,400 120Hz panel, with a Ryzen AI Max+ 395 delivering up to 126 TOPS for local models.

items.headline: AI wearable with 4G LTE: Plaud One can automate workflows for professionals
items.excerpt: The Plaud One Explorer Edition launches with cellular connectivity, aiming to process conversations and meetings and push the results into work tools automatically.

items.headline: Anker just launched a ton of new products at IFA 2026 — including an AI-powered home hub
items.excerpt: Anker used IFA 2026 to unify its brand and announce 22 new products, headlined by its own AI home hub.

items.headline: Best of IFA 2026: We found the 26 top new gadgets
items.excerpt: Tom's Guide picks the 26 standout devices from Berlin, from a hardware AI assistant that watches your screen to screenless wearables and modular robots.

items.headline: Lenovo's new Yoga laptops go all-in on RTX Spark, and they're only part of a massive new lineup
items.excerpt: Lenovo did not come to IFA empty-handed: the Yoga Pro 9n and Yoga 9n pair NVIDIA's RTX Spark Grace-Blackwell chip with up to 128GB unified memory, aimed squarely at creatives and AI builders.

items.headline: Acer's tiny Project DualPlay Mini handheld is built for gaming and getting things done
items.excerpt: The concept device aims to reimagine what a gaming handheld can do, splitting play and productivity into one small dual-purpose body.

items.headline: Minisforum launches local AI solutions at IFA 2026 — AI Agent NAS N5 and AI Mini Workstation MS-S1
items.excerpt: Both boxes use AMD's Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 with up to 131 TOPS and 192GB of unified memory, designed to keep model inference and agent workloads entirely on your desk.

items.headline: M6 MacBook Pro: Three new upgrades launching this fall
items.excerpt: Now that the M6 has been unveiled with its first-ever dual 16-core Neural Engine, here are three upgrades to expect from the M6 MacBook Pro arriving this fall.

items.headline: Gemini overlay gets bubble minimization and multitasking on Android
items.excerpt: The Gemini overlay on Android now has a multitasking option that leaves a floating bubble shortcut when you minimize it, so the assistant persists alongside whatever app you switch to.
